_doc: Single source of truth for /sheets/ — operator paperwork (recipe cost cards, par sheets, daily P&L, etc.). scripts/build-sheets-index.mjs renders the hub at /sheets/index.html and /es/sheets/index.html between <!-- sheets:auto -->...<!-- /sheets:auto --> sentinels. scripts/build-sheet-pages.mjs renders one page per slug from _includes/sheet-shell.html + scripts/sheets-fragments/<slug>.html. Spanish prose lives in data/sheets.es.json. Pack IDs are independent of data/topics.json — sheets have their own organizing taxonomy. status: live | queued. format: table | checklist | log | report. Editing rules: summary ≤ 220 chars; walkaway is exactly one line; pack must exist in packs[]; pairsWith.tools/glossary/blog must reference real slugs (validator is best-effort, broken links surface in pagefind).

packs.blurb_en: The honest paperwork of running an independent restaurant — daily, weekly, monthly. The sheets that keep prime cost from drifting.
packs.blurb_es: El papeleo honesto de operar un restaurante independiente — diario, semanal, mensual. Las hojas que evitan que el costo primo se desborde.

packs.blurb_en: How Google sees your restaurant — and the small habits that keep your listing earning bookings.
packs.blurb_es: Cómo Google ve tu restaurante — y los hábitos pequeños que mantienen tu ficha generando reservas.

packs.blurb_en: What the website and the third-party channels actually deliver — measured against what they cost.
packs.blurb_es: Lo que el sitio y los canales externos realmente entregan — medido contra lo que cuestan.

packs.blurb_en: The handoffs your designer, photographer, and printer need — written down once so the work can move.
packs.blurb_es: Los entregables que tu diseñador, fotógrafo e imprenta necesitan — escritos una vez para que el trabajo avance.

packs.blurb_en: The paperwork that makes you defensible — to a guest, to a health inspector, to an insurer.
packs.blurb_es: El papeleo que te hace defendible — ante un cliente, un inspector de salud, una aseguradora.

recipe-cost-card.summary_en: Drop in ingredients, AP prices, and yields. Walk away with plate cost, target price at your food-cost goal, and a printable card for the binder.
recipe-cost-card.summary_es: Mete ingredientes, precios AP y rendimientos. Llévate el costo del plato, el precio objetivo a tu meta de costo de comida y una tarjeta imprimible para la carpeta.
recipe-cost-card.walkaway_en: A printed cost card with target price and food-cost percent.
recipe-cost-card.walkaway_es: Una tarjeta impresa con precio objetivo y porcentaje de costo de comida.
when_to_use_en: You are about to add a new dish and need a price that holds the food-cost target.
A protein price jumped at receiving and you want to know whether the dish still pays.
Your kitchen lead is asking why the lamb portion needs to drop a quarter-ounce.
mistakes_en: Using the AP price as the cost — the kitchen pays the EP cost after trim and yield.
Forgetting the garnish, the bread, the pickles, the sauce. They add up.
Pricing on cost-plus-50% without checking what the dish across the street goes for.

weekly-prime-cost-worksheet.summary_en: The single most important number a small operator can track. Plug in food, beverage, and labor costs against net sales. See your prime cost percent and where it sits versus the 60 percent ceiling.
weekly-prime-cost-worksheet.summary_es: El número más importante que un operador pequeño puede seguir. Mete costos de comida, bebida y mano de obra contra las ventas netas. Mira tu costo primo y dónde queda frente al techo del 60 por ciento.
weekly-prime-cost-worksheet.walkaway_en: Your prime cost percent, week-over-week trend, and distance from a 60 percent target.
weekly-prime-cost-worksheet.walkaway_es: Tu costo primo en porcentaje, la tendencia semana a semana y la distancia al objetivo del 60 por ciento.
weekly-prime-cost-worksheet.cadence_es: Semanal · martes por la semana anterior
when_to_use_en: Tuesday morning, closing the prior week. Before payroll. Before the produce reorder.
A cost just jumped — you want to see if it landed in the prime cost number or got absorbed.
You are talking to a partner or lender and need a one-number answer about restaurant health.
mistakes_en: Forgetting employer payroll taxes and benefits inside labor — the result reads 4 to 6 points low.
Using sales tax-inclusive revenue. Net of sales tax, every time, or the percent is wrong.
Counting only food in COGS — beverage prime cost runs different and needs its own line.

third-party-channel-pnl.summary_en: Run the honest math on DoorDash, Uber Eats, or Grubhub. Gross sales minus commission, marketing fees, refunds, packaging, and the labor those orders cost. Settles the argument.
third-party-channel-pnl.summary_es: Corre las cuentas honestas de DoorDash, Uber Eats o Grubhub. Ventas brutas menos comisión, tarifas de marketing, reembolsos, empaques y la mano de obra que cuestan esos pedidos. Cierra la discusión.
third-party-channel-pnl.walkaway_en: True margin per channel and the breakeven menu markup if you keep the channel on.
third-party-channel-pnl.walkaway_es: Margen real por canal y el margen de menú de equilibrio si mantienes el canal activo.
when_to_use_en: End of month, when the platforms have settled and you have the real fee picture.
When a marketing rep calls and offers "a free promo" — see if it actually breaks even.
Before you decide whether to keep one of the three platforms turned on.
mistakes_en: Treating promo subsidies as revenue. The subsidy ends; the discount habit does not.
Ignoring packaging cost. A clamshell, a lid, a sticker, a bag — easily 90 cents per ticket.
Forgetting incremental labor. Delivery tickets eat expo and packing time you would not bill direct.

gbp-monthly-audit.title_es: Chequeo mensual de Google Business Profile
gbp-monthly-audit.summary_en: Fifteen-minute walk of your Google Business Profile. Hours, primary category, photo count, posts, Q&A, review velocity, NAP match versus your website. Pass or fail per row, with a fix list.
gbp-monthly-audit.summary_es: Recorrido de quince minutos por tu Google Business Profile. Horarios, categoría principal, conteo de fotos, posts, Q&A, velocidad de reseñas, coincidencia NAP con tu sitio. Pasa o falla por fila, con lista de arreglos.
gbp-monthly-audit.walkaway_en: A monthly punch list: what is current, what drifted, what to fix this week.
gbp-monthly-audit.walkaway_es: Una lista mensual: qué está al día, qué se desfasó, qué arreglar esta semana.
when_to_use_en: First Monday of every month — fifteen minutes, with the GBP open in another tab.
Any time bookings dip and you have not changed anything on the website.
Right after a menu change, holiday week, or hours update.
mistakes_en: Counting auto-imported user photos as fresh content. They are not. Owners post owner-photos.
Ignoring secondary categories. The wrong primary plus a missing secondary is a real ranking gap.
Letting Q&A sit unanswered. Google treats unanswered Q&A as low-engagement signal.

daily-sales-recap.title_es: Resumen diario de ventas y cubiertos
daily-sales-recap.summary_en: End-of-night close-out, one page per shift. Net sales, covers, voids, comps, cash over and short, weather note, manager initials.
daily-sales-recap.summary_es: Cierre de noche, una página por turno. Ventas netas, cubiertos, anulaciones, cortesías, sobrante o faltante de caja, nota del clima, iniciales del gerente.
daily-sales-recap.walkaway_en: Average check, voids as percent of sales, anomaly flag versus your trailing 14-day average.
daily-sales-recap.walkaway_es: Cheque promedio, anulaciones como porcentaje de ventas, alerta versus el promedio móvil de 14 días.
when_to_use_en: Right at close, before the manager leaves the building.
Comparing tonight to a typical Tuesday — was the dip weather, schedule, or something else?
Spotting a void rate that drifts above 1% of sales — that is where theft hides.
mistakes_en: Logging gross sales instead of net (sales tax included). Use net every time.
Skipping the cash over/short field on busy nights — the field exists for the busy nights.
Not noting weather. A 30% dip on a clear Saturday is a different problem than the same dip in a snowstorm.

line-check-sheet.summary_en: Ten-minute walk before doors open — temps, prep par, 86 list, expo notes. Lives on a clipboard; built to print.
line-check-sheet.summary_es: Recorrido de diez minutos antes de abrir — temperaturas, par de prep, lista 86, notas de expo. Vive en una tabla; hecho para imprimir.
line-check-sheet.walkaway_en: An 86 list, a prep gap list, and a temp-log paper trail for the health inspector.
line-check-sheet.walkaway_es: Lista de 86, lista de huecos de prep y un registro impreso de temperaturas para el inspector.
when_to_use_en: Twenty minutes before doors open — lunch and dinner separately.
When the previous shift's manager left a note about a temp-log gap.
Right after a vendor delivery so you catch a temperature problem before service.
mistakes_en: Initialing without checking the temps. The walk is the point; the signature is the proof.
Not dating the printout. Health inspectors want the date, not just the day of the week.
Putting the 86 list in the manager's pocket instead of expo. The line cannot read your pocket.

waste-log.summary_en: Translate "we throw a lot away" into a dollar number nobody can argue with. Item, quantity, reason code, cost.
waste-log.summary_es: Convierte "se tira mucho" en una cifra en pesos que nadie puede discutir. Item, cantidad, código de razón, costo.
waste-log.walkaway_en: Weekly waste in dollars, your top 5 offenders, and the reason-code mix.
waste-log.walkaway_es: Desperdicio semanal en pesos, tus 5 ofensores principales y la mezcla de códigos de razón.
when_to_use_en: Every time a kitchen lead drops something, throws spoiled prep, or hands off staff meal.
Tuesday morning, when the weekly review names the top three offenders.
Any time someone says "we throw a lot away" — make them cite the number.
mistakes_en: Mixing staff-meal with spoilage. Staff meal is a labor benefit; spoilage is a margin leak.
Skipping the reason code. Without the code, the log just says "we wasted things."
Not pricing the line. A waste log without dollars is a feelings journal.

invoice-receiving-checklist.summary_en: Catch short-shipped, substituted, or price-creep items at the back door — before the truck leaves. Vendor, line, qty ordered versus received, unit-price change, temps for proteins and dairy.
invoice-receiving-checklist.summary_es: Atrapa items cortos, sustituidos o con precio inflado en la puerta trasera — antes de que el camión se vaya. Proveedor, línea, cantidad pedida versus recibida, cambio de precio unitario, temperaturas de proteínas y lácteos.
invoice-receiving-checklist.walkaway_en: A credit-request flag list and a unit-cost change list for your buyer.
invoice-receiving-checklist.walkaway_es: Una lista de solicitudes de crédito y una lista de cambios de costo unitario para el comprador.
when_to_use_en: Standing at the back door while the driver is still there.
Whenever a substitution shows up that you did not approve in writing.
Right after a price-increase notice from a vendor — verify the new price hits the line.
mistakes_en: Signing the slip before counting the boxes. Once it's signed, the credit conversation is uphill.
Not flagging substitutions in writing. "They were out" is not a credit; "item swap, no approval" is.
Skipping the protein temp on cold winter mornings. The truck cooler can fail in any weather.

monthly-pnl-snapshot.summary_en: A one-page P&L the operator can read in 90 seconds — not the accountant's version. Sales by daypart, COGS, labor, occupancy, marketing.
monthly-pnl-snapshot.summary_es: Un P&G de una página que el operador lee en 90 segundos — no la versión del contador. Ventas por daypart, costo de mercancía, mano de obra, ocupación, marketing.
monthly-pnl-snapshot.walkaway_en: Prime cost percent, contribution margin percent, breakeven sales per day.
monthly-pnl-snapshot.walkaway_es: Costo primo en porcentaje, margen de contribución en porcentaje, ventas de equilibrio por día.
when_to_use_en: First week of every month, against the prior month closed by your bookkeeper.
Before sitting down with a partner, lender, or landlord about the business.
After a menu change, price raise, or labor reset — see what actually moved.
mistakes_en: Lumping owner draw into labor. Owner pay is a distribution; labor is the line that pays the staff.
Forgetting credit-card fees as a variable cost. 2.6% on every dine-in dollar is not rounding error.
Counting marketing as fixed when half is platform-promo subsidy. The subsidy ends; the cost stays.

inventory-count-sheet.title_es: Hoja de conteo de inventario fin de periodo
inventory-count-sheet.summary_en: Walk-through count, organized by storage location, not alphabet. Counted on a clipboard, keyed in later.
inventory-count-sheet.summary_es: Conteo a mano, organizado por ubicación de almacenamiento, no alfabéticamente. Contado en tabla, capturado después.
inventory-count-sheet.walkaway_en: Total inventory dollars by category and a variance list versus theoretical use.
inventory-count-sheet.walkaway_es: Inventario total en pesos por categoría y una lista de variación contra el uso teórico.
when_to_use_en: Last day of the period, after the close, two people walking together.
Whenever the prime cost number reads off and you suspect a count miss.
Before a vendor switch — start the new vendor at a known opening number.
mistakes_en: Counting sealed cases as open weight. A case of #10 cans is not the same line as opened pulls.
Counting in random order. The next person who recounts has to do it the same way.
Skipping the bar walk-in because "beverage is small." Beverage is where the highest-margin theft hides.

cash-handling-log.title_es: Registro de depósito y entrega de efectivo
cash-handling-log.summary_en: Chain of custody for cash from drawer to bank. Drawer number, opening bank, cash sales, paid-outs, drop, two initials, deposit slip number.
cash-handling-log.summary_es: Cadena de custodia del efectivo desde la caja hasta el banco. Número de caja, banco inicial, ventas en efectivo, pagos, entrega, dos iniciales, número de boleta de depósito.
cash-handling-log.walkaway_en: Over and short by drawer, by employee, by shift.
cash-handling-log.walkaway_es: Sobrante y faltante por caja, por empleado, por turno.
when_to_use_en: Every cash drop. Every drawer change. Every deposit prep.
Whenever a single drawer reads more than $10 over or short — the trend matters.
Before any conversation with an employee about a discrepancy — bring the log, not the memory.
mistakes_en: Single-initial drops. Two pairs of eyes is the entire point of the chain of custody.
No paid-out receipts attached. Cash that left the drawer needs a paper reason.
Depositing without recording the slip number. The bank can lose a slip; you cannot lose the number.

nap-consistency-tracker.summary_en: Same name, address, phone everywhere — Google Business Profile, Yelp, Apple, TripAdvisor, OpenTable, your own footer, your schema. One mismatch and Google starts doubting which one is you.
nap-consistency-tracker.summary_es: El mismo nombre, dirección y teléfono en todos lados — Google Business Profile, Yelp, Apple, TripAdvisor, OpenTable, tu pie de página, tu schema. Una inconsistencia y Google empieza a dudar cuál eres.
nap-consistency-tracker.walkaway_en: A mismatch list and a priority-fix order across 12 citation sources.
nap-consistency-tracker.walkaway_es: Una lista de inconsistencias y un orden de prioridad de arreglos en 12 fuentes de citación.
when_to_use_en: Quarterly — once a quarter is enough to catch what drifts.
After a phone number change, suite move, or rebrand.
Whenever Google Search Console flags a duplicate-listing issue.
mistakes_en: Treating "Suite 200" and "Ste 200" as identical. Google does not.
Phone with vs. without country code — both can co-exist; only one belongs in your NAP.
Forgetting the schema block on the website. Visible footer is one source; the JSON-LD is another.

holiday-hours-planner.summary_en: A quarter ahead of every federal and local holiday — planned hours, GBP updated yes or no, website updated, voicemail updated.
holiday-hours-planner.summary_es: Un trimestre antes de cada feriado federal y local — horarios planeados, GBP actualizado, sitio actualizado, contestadora actualizada.
holiday-hours-planner.walkaway_en: A punch list with deadlines, by holiday, by surface.
holiday-hours-planner.walkaway_es: Una lista accionable con fechas, por feriado, por superficie.
when_to_use_en: First week of each quarter — plan three months of holidays at once.
Right after a holiday week — review what missed and capture the lessons.
Before any planned closure — staff vacation, equipment swap, private buyout.
mistakes_en: Forgetting voicemail. Google and the website agree; the recording still says "Open daily."
Setting Google special hours less than two weeks ahead — slow indexing means the diner sees stale info.
Using GBP "closed" instead of "closes early" for an early shutdown — "closed" all day suppresses the listing.

local-keyword-map.title_es: Mapa de palabras clave locales por página
local-keyword-map.summary_en: Which keyword each page targets, neighborhood modifier, current rank, page H1, schema type. Surfaces cannibalization and coverage gaps.
local-keyword-map.summary_es: Qué palabra clave apunta cada página, modificador de barrio, posición actual, H1, tipo de schema. Saca a la luz canibalización y huecos de cobertura.
local-keyword-map.walkaway_en: Coverage gaps and cannibalization flags ready for the content calendar.
local-keyword-map.walkaway_es: Huecos de cobertura y señales de canibalización listas para el calendario de contenido.
when_to_use_en: Quarterly, with Search Console open in the next tab.
Before adding a new page — does it cannibalize one that already ranks?
After a content rewrite — verify the keyword map matches the new page.
mistakes_en: Targeting the same keyword on three pages. Google picks one; the other two split the signal and suppress all three.
Using city-only keywords when neighborhood-modified terms convert better — "silver spring brunch" beats "silver spring restaurant" for intent.
Mapping by gut instead of by query data. Search Console says what people actually typed; trust it.

photo-refresh-tracker.summary_en: Channel — GBP, Instagram, website, Yelp — by shot type, by last upload date. Catches stale heroes and the channel you forgot about.
photo-refresh-tracker.summary_es: Canal — GBP, Instagram, sitio, Yelp — por tipo de toma, por última fecha de subida. Atrapa hero shots viejos y el canal que olvidaste.
photo-refresh-tracker.walkaway_en: Channels overdue for content and a shot-type gap list for the next shoot.
photo-refresh-tracker.walkaway_es: Canales atrasados de contenido y lista de tipos de toma faltantes para la próxima sesión.
when_to_use_en: Monthly — fifteen minutes with the four channels open in tabs.
After a menu change — every dropped dish has a stale photo somewhere.
When a channel goes a month without a fresh upload from the owner.
mistakes_en: Reusing the same hero shot across all four channels. Each channel has a native aspect ratio; one shot can't satisfy all.
Uploading vertical photos to website slots that are landscape. Crop forced; the dish gets cut in half.
Counting auto-imported user photos on GBP as "new content." They are not — owner-uploaded counts.

reservation-no-show-log.summary_en: Booking source, party size, deposit yes or no, showed or no-show or late-cancel, revenue lost. Names what each empty seat actually cost.
reservation-no-show-log.summary_es: Fuente de reserva, tamaño del grupo, depósito sí o no, llegó o no-show o cancelación tardía, ingreso perdido. Nombra lo que cada silla vacía costó.
reservation-no-show-log.walkaway_en: No-show rate by source and lost revenue per week, priced.
reservation-no-show-log.walkaway_es: Tasa de no-show por fuente e ingreso perdido por semana, valorado.
when_to_use_en: Daily — log every confirmed reservation as it cancels, no-shows, or sits.
End of week, when you price the empty seats. The number lands different than the feeling.
Before deciding whether to require a deposit or a credit-card hold by booking source.
mistakes_en: Treating late-cancels and no-shows as the same row. Late-cancel had a chance to refill; no-show didn’t.
Not pricing the empty seat. "Two no-shows tonight" sounds small; "$140 in lost revenue" doesn’t.
Logging only direct reservations. The booking source is the lever — if Resy no-shows are 3× OpenTable, the policy is by source, not blanket.

website-conversion-checklist.summary_en: Mobile menu loads in three seconds, click-to-call above the fold, reservation CTA above the fold, hours visible, address tap-to-map, allergen and menu PDFs mobile-readable.
website-conversion-checklist.summary_es: Menú móvil carga en tres segundos, click-to-call sobre el fold, CTA de reserva sobre el fold, horarios visibles, dirección tap-to-map, PDFs de alérgenos y menú legibles en móvil.
website-conversion-checklist.walkaway_en: Pass-or-fail per row, with fix priority for the developer.
website-conversion-checklist.walkaway_es: Pasa o falla por fila, con prioridad de arreglo para el desarrollador.
when_to_use_en: Quarterly — once a quarter on the live site, with a real iPhone, not a desktop emulator.
After any redesign or platform migration. The before-and-after pairs naturally with the speed-test sheet.
When bookings dip and the GBP audit comes back clean — the leak is on the site itself.
mistakes_en: Phone number rendered as an image instead of a tel: link. Click-to-call is the highest-converting CTA on a restaurant site.
Menu PDF that pinches on mobile. If a guest has to zoom, the menu is the friction.
Hiding hours below the fold. Diners check hours on Friday at 4pm; "open today?" is the question your homepage answers in 2 seconds or fails.

daypart-traffic-map.summary_en: Day by hour grid — covers, sales, labor hours. Reveals where you are paying for staff that has nothing to serve.
daypart-traffic-map.summary_es: Cuadrícula día por hora — cubiertos, ventas, horas de mano de obra. Revela dónde pagas personal que no tiene a quién servir.
daypart-traffic-map.walkaway_en: Sales-per-labor-hour heatmap and the obvious scheduling cuts.
daypart-traffic-map.walkaway_es: Mapa de calor de ventas por hora-empleado y los recortes obvios de horario.
when_to_use_en: Monthly — pull POS reports for covers, sales, and labor hours by hour-of-day.
Before a schedule rewrite. The map names the cuts that don't hurt service.
When considering a new daypart (lunch launch, Sunday brunch, late-night) — the heatmap shows whether the demand is there.
mistakes_en: Mixing dine-in and to-go in one cell. The labor cost of each daypart differs by channel; combining hides the truth.
Cutting labor on the slowest hour without checking the trend. One slow Wednesday at 4pm is noise; eight slow Wednesdays is signal.
Forgetting opening labor (prep cooks, BOH setup) — they don't show in covers but they are real.

email-list-growth-log.title_es: Registro de crecimiento de lista de correo y SMS
email-list-growth-log.summary_en: Source by month — table tent, QR, reservation, online order — with new sign-ups, unsubs, opens, clicks. Names which channels actually grow the list.
email-list-growth-log.summary_es: Fuente por mes — table tent, QR, reserva, pedido online — con altas nuevas, bajas, aperturas, clics. Nombra qué canales realmente crecen la lista.
email-list-growth-log.walkaway_en: Channel ROI and a list-health score.
email-list-growth-log.walkaway_es: ROI por canal y un puntaje de salud de la lista.
when_to_use_en: Monthly — first week, pulling subscriber stats from your sender (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ConvertKit, etc.).
Before launching a new capture point — table tent, QR code, online-order checkbox — to set a baseline.
When unsubscribes spike — the source attribution names which channel is misaligned with what you send.
mistakes_en: Counting sign-ups without engagement. A list of 5,000 with 6% open rate is worth less than 800 at 40%.
Using a single capture form with no source tag — without source, the ROI question is unanswerable.
Sending the same cadence to every source. Reservation sign-ups want different content than a checkout opt-in.

menu-redesign-brief.summary_en: What the designer needs to do the work — top 10 sellers, dogs to cut, price changes, callout items, dietary flags, print and digital and POS targets.
menu-redesign-brief.summary_es: Lo que el diseñador necesita para trabajar — top 10 ventas, items a cortar, cambios de precio, items destacados, marcas dietéticas, objetivos impresos, digitales y POS.
menu-redesign-brief.walkaway_en: A designer-ready spec, in one page.
menu-redesign-brief.walkaway_es: Una especificación lista para diseñador, en una página.
when_to_use_en: Six to eighteen months in — when the menu has drifted enough that the printout no longer matches the kitchen.
Before sending to the designer. The brief is what makes their work fast and yours predictable.
After a price raise or item cut — formalize the change so the designer doesn't redesign around stale data.
mistakes_en: Reordering items without re-engineering the categories. The grid (popularity × margin) is the engineering; the layout is downstream.
Skipping the dietary markers and allergen flags. Those go in the brief or the menu ships missing them.
Sending the brief without your top-10 sellers. The designer can balance the layout only if they know what you actually sell.

brand-asset-inventory.summary_en: Asset type, file location, last updated, owner, license. Catches the logo that only exists on a former employee's laptop.
brand-asset-inventory.summary_es: Tipo de activo, ubicación del archivo, última actualización, dueño, licencia. Atrapa el logo que solo existe en la laptop de un ex-empleado.
brand-asset-inventory.walkaway_en: A missing-asset list and a license-risk flag list.
brand-asset-inventory.walkaway_es: Una lista de activos faltantes y una lista de riesgos de licencia.
when_to_use_en: Quarterly review — find the asset that disappeared and the license about to lapse.
Onboarding a new designer or marketing hire — they get the inventory before they get the work.
Before any rebrand — you cannot redesign what you cannot find.
mistakes_en: Logos stored only on a former employee's laptop. Make the cloud the source of truth, not the heirloom.
No license records. A stock-photo contract that lapsed is a lawsuit waiting to happen.
Mixing working files with deliverables. The .ai source and the exported PNG are different artifacts; track both.

signage-spec-sheet.title_es: Hoja de especificación de letreros e impresos
signage-spec-sheet.summary_en: Sign type, dimensions, material, color codes, mounting, vendor, install date. Hands the printer everything they need to start.
signage-spec-sheet.summary_es: Tipo de letrero, dimensiones, material, códigos de color, montaje, proveedor, fecha de instalación. Le da a la imprenta todo lo que necesita para empezar.
signage-spec-sheet.walkaway_en: A print-ready spec with no Pantone-versus-CMYK confusion.
signage-spec-sheet.walkaway_es: Una especificación lista para imprenta, sin confusión Pantone-versus-CMYK.
when_to_use_en: Before commissioning new signage, awnings, or printed graphics — your printer needs every spec.
When ordering reorders — the spec sheet is the proof the new batch matches the old.
Before a permit application — the spec is the document you submit to the city.
mistakes_en: Pantone codes for a CMYK print job — the print shop will substitute and you won't see it until install.
Missing the mounting detail. "Flush mount" vs "stand-off" changes the install bill, not just the look.
No bleed / safety zone marked. The print shop trims; what was on the edge is now off the edge.

photo-shot-list.title_es: Lista de tomas para sesión de fotos
photo-shot-list.summary_en: Dish, plate type, garnish, props, channel target, priority. Lives on set, ticks off as you go.
photo-shot-list.summary_es: Plato, tipo de plato, decoración, props, canal destino, prioridad. Vive en el set, se va tachando.
photo-shot-list.walkaway_en: The photographer's day-of plan with no skipped shots.
photo-shot-list.walkaway_es: El plan del día del fotógrafo, sin tomas saltadas.
when_to_use_en: Two weeks before a shoot — gives the kitchen time to source garnishes and rehearse plating.
On set — paper, on a clipboard, ticked off as each shot lands.
After the shoot — the list is what you compare against to confirm everything got captured.
mistakes_en: No backup dish for the shot that bombs. Plating fails happen; the photographer does not have time to wait.
Listing the dish without naming the channel target. A 4:3 menu shot and a 9:16 Reel cover are different shoots.
Forgetting the props the photographer asked for. Linens, glassware, a backup garnish — all on the list.

social-content-calendar.summary_en: Date, channel, post type, asset link, caption draft, CTA, status. Thirty days planned at a time so you stop posting the same hero shot.
social-content-calendar.summary_es: Fecha, canal, tipo de post, link del activo, borrador del copy, CTA, estado. Treinta días planeados a la vez para dejar de subir la misma foto.
social-content-calendar.walkaway_en: A 30-day plan that mixes food, people, and place.
social-content-calendar.walkaway_es: Un plan de 30 días que mezcla comida, personas y lugar.
when_to_use_en: Last week of every month — plan the next 30 days before the urgent eats the important.
Around any holiday or event — plan content alongside the holiday-hours-planner so the messages match.
After a menu change — content needs to lead the swap, not lag it.
mistakes_en: Posting only food. Mix in people, place, and process — guests follow restaurants for the room as much as the plate.
No CTA on a single post. Every post answers "what now?" — book, order, follow, or share.
Scheduling without dates. "Coming soon" is not a calendar; a date and channel are.

vendor-contact-sheet.summary_en: Vendor, contact, phone, email, account number, delivery days, payment terms. Lives by the office phone for the day a vendor disappears.
vendor-contact-sheet.summary_es: Proveedor, contacto, teléfono, correo, número de cuenta, días de entrega, condiciones de pago. Vive junto al teléfono de la oficina para el día que un proveedor desaparezca.
vendor-contact-sheet.walkaway_es: Una referencia de emergencia de una página.
when_to_use_en: When the dishwasher breaks at 7pm on a Saturday and you need the equipment vendor's after-hours number.
Quarterly review — call each contact, verify they still work there, update the sheet.
Onboarding any new manager — they get the list before they get a key.
mistakes_en: Out-of-date sales-rep names. People move; the account number stays. Verify quarterly.
Missing the after-hours line. The 9-to-5 line is great until it isn't 9-to-5.
Storing it digital-only. The phone is dead, the WiFi is out — the printed sheet by the office phone is the safety net.

review-response-log.summary_en: Platform, reviewer, stars, theme tag, response date, responder, follow-up needed. Catches the recurring complaint hiding in the 3-star reviews.
review-response-log.summary_es: Plataforma, autor, estrellas, etiqueta de tema, fecha de respuesta, quien respondió, seguimiento. Atrapa la queja recurrente escondida en las reseñas de 3 estrellas.
review-response-log.walkaway_en: Response-rate percent and the top recurring complaint themes.
review-response-log.walkaway_es: Tasa de respuesta en porcentaje y los temas de queja más recurrentes.
when_to_use_en: Weekly — fifteen minutes, with the GBP / Yelp / Tripadvisor inboxes open.
After every 1- or 2-star review — those need a response within 48 hours, every time.
When a complaint theme repeats — the log surfaces the pattern that one-off reviews hide.
mistakes_en: Responding only to 5-stars. Google reads the response rate on negatives as a quality signal.
Generic responses ("thanks for your feedback") on detailed complaints. The reviewer wrote 200 words; respect them.
Logging the response date but not the THEME tag. Without themes, you cannot run the pattern review.

complaint-root-cause-tracker.title_es: Seguimiento de causa raíz de quejas
complaint-root-cause-tracker.summary_en: Date, channel, category, root cause, fix, owner. Logs the cause, not the symptom — "expo gap," not "cold food."
complaint-root-cause-tracker.summary_es: Fecha, canal, categoría, causa raíz, arreglo, dueño. Registra la causa, no el síntoma — "hueco en expo," no "comida fría."
complaint-root-cause-tracker.walkaway_en: Top three recurring causes and who owns each fix.
complaint-root-cause-tracker.walkaway_es: Las tres causas recurrentes principales y quién es dueño de cada arreglo.
when_to_use_en: Weekly review of the prior week's complaints — across in-house, online, and DM channels.
When a complaint theme repeats three times in one month — that is no longer noise.
After a service incident that produced a manager intervention — the cause logs there, not just the comp.
mistakes_en: Logging the symptom ("cold food") instead of the cause ("expo gap on Saturday dinner"). Symptoms are signals; causes are fixes.
Not assigning an owner. A complaint without an owner is a complaint that recurs.
Closing the log without verifying the fix held the next week. "Fixed" is a hypothesis until the next complaint cycle proves it.

health-inspection-prep.title_es: Lista de preparación para inspección sanitaria
health-inspection-prep.summary_en: Last violation list, temp logs current, hand-sink stocked, chemical labels, dating system, certifications posted. Treats inspection-ready as standing practice.
health-inspection-prep.summary_es: Última lista de violaciones, registros de temperatura al día, lavabo de manos abastecido, etiquetas químicas, sistema de fechas, certificaciones a la vista. Trata el estar listo como práctica permanente.
health-inspection-prep.walkaway_en: Pass-or-fail per row, ready for an unannounced visit.
health-inspection-prep.walkaway_es: Pasa o falla por fila, listo para una visita sin aviso.
when_to_use_en: Quarterly — between routine inspections, with the last violation list in hand.
Day before any pre-announced inspection — final walk to catch anything that drifted.
After a violation — the corrective-action verification belongs on this sheet.
mistakes_en: Treating the inspection as a one-day prep instead of standing practice. The sheet exists to make it standing.
Letting temp logs go more than 24 hours without an entry. The gap is the violation, not the temperature.
Storing the dating system label (FIFO stickers, day-dot system) where the inspector cannot see it.

staff-onboarding-checklist.summary_en: Tour, uniform, POS login, food-handler card, manager intro, week-one trail shifts. Operational only — no I-9, no W-4, no state new-hire reporting.
staff-onboarding-checklist.summary_es: Recorrido, uniforme, login del POS, carnet de manipulador, presentación con el gerente, turnos de seguimiento la primera semana. Solo operativo — sin I-9, sin W-4, sin reportes estatales.
staff-onboarding-checklist.walkaway_en: Day-one readiness for the cook or server who just started.
staff-onboarding-checklist.walkaway_es: Listo para el primer día del cocinero o mesero que recién entra.
when_to_use_en: Day one of every new hire — front-of-house, back-of-house, host, dishwasher, all of them.
When promoting from within — onboard them into the new role, do not assume they have it.
Back-to-back with the orientation packet — the checklist is the proof of completion.
mistakes_en: Confusing this with HR onboarding. This is operational only — no I-9, no W-4, no state new-hire reporting.
Skipping the manager-on-duty intro. The new hire needs to know who to ask before service starts.
Treating the trail shifts as informal. Schedule them, log them, debrief after each.

incident-report.summary_en: Date and time, location, persons, witnesses, description, photos, actions taken, manager signature. Filled the day it happens, not the week after.
incident-report.summary_es: Fecha y hora, lugar, personas, testigos, descripción, fotos, acciones tomadas, firma del gerente. Se llena el día del incidente, no la semana después.
incident-report.walkaway_en: An ink-signed record your insurer can use.
incident-report.walkaway_es: Un registro firmado a mano que tu aseguradora puede usar.
when_to_use_en: The day it happens — never the week after. Memory is unreliable in legal proceedings.
Even for incidents that resolve on the spot — the paper trail is the protection.
Anything involving an injury, a slip, an allergen reaction, or a customer-staff altercation.
mistakes_en: Filling it out from memory days later. Time, exact words, witnesses — all degrade fast.
Skipping the witness signatures. A witness who confirms today is hard to call back next year.
Not photographing the scene. The phone in your pocket is part of the report.

allergen-matrix.summary_en: Menu item by top-9 US allergens grid, with modifications-on-request notes. Updates with every menu change. Server reference, liability defense.
allergen-matrix.summary_es: Item del menú por los 9 alérgenos principales de EE.UU., con notas de modificaciones a pedido. Se actualiza con cada cambio de menú. Referencia para meseros, defensa legal.
allergen-matrix.walkaway_en: A printable grid for the service line and a digital version for the website.
allergen-matrix.walkaway_es: Una cuadrícula imprimible para la línea de servicio y una versión digital para el sitio.
allergen-matrix.cadence_en: Quarterly · plus on every menu change
allergen-matrix.cadence_es: Trimestral · más cada cambio de menú
when_to_use_en: Quarterly — every menu change, every supplier swap, every new prep recipe.
Before training a new server — the matrix is the reference they cite to a guest.
After any allergen reaction — verify the matrix matches what the kitchen actually does.
mistakes_en: Updating the menu but not the matrix. The lag is where allergen incidents happen.
Conflating "contains" with "may contain" (cross-contact). The grid needs both columns.
Using a Google search to fill in a hidden ingredient. Verify with the supplier spec sheet, every time.

_exclusions.policy_en: Operator Sheets do not cover payroll calculation, tax filing, tip-pool allocation, predictive-scheduling forms, I-9 / W-4 / state new-hire reporting. These are jurisdiction-specific and a small site cannot maintain accurate forms across 50 states. We name what we exclude rather than ship something that could land an operator on the wrong side of a law.
_exclusions.policy_es: Las Hojas del Operador no cubren cálculo de nómina, declaración de impuestos, asignación de pool de propinas, formularios de horarios predictivos, I-9 / W-4 / reportes estatales de nuevos empleados. Son específicos por jurisdicción y un sitio pequeño no puede mantener formularios precisos en los 50 estados. Nombramos lo que excluimos en vez de publicar algo que podría dejar a un operador del lado equivocado de la ley.

_locale_hazard_notice.en: These sheets vary by jurisdiction. Verify with your local authority before signing or distributing.
_locale_hazard_notice.es: Estas hojas varían según la jurisdicción. Verifica con tu autoridad local antes de firmar o distribuir.
